ja: アイルランドの正当な女王であると宣言しました。これは当時大胆な主張でした。メアリーがスコットランドに戻ると、彼女はこの
local: Ireland, a bold assertion at the time. When Mary returns to Scotland, she continues to carry this

zh: 伊麗莎白感到懷疑甚至敵對，並為歷史上最著名的競爭之一奠定了基礎，

en: in history. One thousand five hundred sixty-four, Mary Stewart has been back in Scotland for
zh: 歷史上。1564年，瑪麗·斯圖亞特已經回到蘇格蘭
ja: 歴史上のことです。1564年、メアリー・スチュワートはスコットランドに戻ってから
local: in history. One thousand five hundred sixty-four, Mary Stewart has been back in Scotland for
ja_pron: Rekishi-jō no koto desu. 1564-nen, Mearī Suchuwāto wa Sukottorando ni modotte kara
native: in history. One thousand five hundred sixty-four, Mary Stewart has been back in Scotland for

en: three years and still unmarried. The pressure is growing, marriage is not just a political duty,
zh: 三年了仍未結婚。壓力越來越大，婚姻不僅是政治責任，
ja: 3年経ってもまだ未婚です。プレッシャーが高まっており、結婚は単なる政治的義務ではありません。
local: three years and still unmarried. The pressure is growing, marriage is not just a political duty,
native: three years and still unmarried. The pressure is growing, marriage is not just a political duty,

en: but also fits Mary's own self-image, as a woman, as a queen and as a future mother of a royal
zh: 而且符合瑪麗作為女性、女王及未來皇室母親的自我形象，
ja: しかし、それは女性として、女王として、そして王朝の未来の母としてのメアリー自身の自己イメージにも合っています。
local: but also fits Mary's own self-image, as a woman, as a queen and as a future mother of a royal
native: but also fits Mary's own self-image, as a woman, as a queen and as a future mother of a royal

en: dynasty. Marriage proposals are coming in from across Europe, more than a dozen suitors are vying
zh: 王朝。來自全歐洲的求婚不斷湧入，十多位追求者競相爭奪，
ja: 王朝です。ヨーロッパ中から結婚の申し込みがあり、12人以上の求婚者が競っています。
local: dynasty. Marriage proposals are coming in from across Europe, more than a dozen suitors are vying
native: dynasty. Marriage proposals are coming in from across Europe, more than a dozen suitors are vying

en: for the young Queen's hand. Even King Philip II of Spain shows interest, the very one who previously
zh: 爭取年輕女王的青睞。甚至西班牙的菲利普二世國王也表現出興趣，他曾追求過伊莉莎白一世。
ja: 若き女王の手を求めています。かつてエリザベス1世に求婚したスペインのフェリペ2世も関心を示しています。
local: for the young Queen's hand. Even King Philip II of Spain shows interest, the very one who previously
native: for the young Queen's hand. Even King Philip II of Spain shows interest, the very one who previously

en: pursued Elizabeth I had courted. But she chooses someone from her own family, Henry Stewart,
zh: 追求過伊莉莎白一世。但她選擇了自己的家族成員，亨利·斯圖爾特，
ja: エリザベス1世に求婚した人物です。しかし彼女は自分の家族の一人、ヘンリー・スチュアートを選びます。
local: pursued Elizabeth I had courted. But she chooses someone from her own family, Henry Stewart,
native: pursued Elizabeth I had courted. But she chooses someone from her own family, Henry Stewart,

en: Lord Darnley, three years her junior of noble birth, strikingly handsome and Catholic.
zh: 達恩利勳爵，比她小三歲，出身貴族，英俊且信奉天主教。
ja: ダーンリー卿は彼女より3歳年下の貴族出身で、非常にハンサムでカトリック教徒です。
local: Lord Darnley, three years her junior of noble birth, strikingly handsome and Catholic.
native: Lord Darnley, three years her junior of noble birth, strikingly handsome and Catholic.

en: Like Mary, he is also a great grandchild of Henry VII of England. That makes him her equal in rank
zh: 和瑪麗一樣，他也是英格蘭亨利七世的曾孫。這使他在地位上與她平等，
ja: メアリーと同様に、彼もイングランドのヘンリー7世の曾孫です。これにより彼は彼女と同格の地位となります。
local: Like Mary, he is also a great grandchild of Henry VII of England. That makes him her equal in rank
native: Like Mary, he is also a great grandchild of Henry VII of England. That makes him her equal in rank

en: and a potential father of English Scottish heirs to the throne.
zh: 也是英格蘭與蘇格蘭王位繼承人的潛在父親。
ja: そしてイングランドとスコットランドの王位継承者の父となる可能性があります。
local: and a potential father of English Scottish heirs to the throne.
native: and a potential father of English Scottish heirs to the throne.

en: July 1565 Mary Stewart marries Lord Darnley, three months later she is pregnant.
zh: 1565年7月，瑪麗·斯圖爾特與達恩利勳爵結婚，三個月後她懷孕了。
ja: 1565年7月、メアリー・スチュアートはダーンリー卿と結婚し、3か月後に妊娠しました。
local: July 1565 Mary Stewart marries Lord Darnley, three months later she is pregnant.
native: July 1565 Mary Stewart marries Lord Darnley, three months later she is pregnant.

en: All of Scotland celebrates the hoped for heir seems secured, but not everyone is cheering.
zh: 全蘇格蘭慶祝這位期望中的繼承人似乎已經確定，但並非所有人都歡呼。
ja: スコットランド全土が期待される後継者の誕生を祝いますが、全員が喜んでいるわけではありません。
local: All of Scotland celebrates the hoped for heir seems secured, but not everyone is cheering.
native: All of Scotland celebrates the hoped for heir seems secured, but not everyone is cheering.

en: Her half-brother James Stewart, Scotland's secret ruler, sees his power fading.
zh: 她的同父異母兄弟詹姆斯·斯圖爾特，蘇格蘭的幕後統治者，看到自己的權力正在減弱。
ja: 彼女の異母兄弟でありスコットランドの秘密の支配者であるジェームズ・スチュアートは、自分の権力が衰えているのを感じています。
local: Her half-brother James Stewart, Scotland's secret ruler, sees his power fading.
native: Her half-brother James Stewart, Scotland's secret ruler, sees his power fading.

en: With the wedding, Darnley becomes King and James loses his grip on power.
zh: 隨著婚禮，達恩利成為國王，詹姆斯失去了對權力的掌控。
ja: 結婚によりダーンリーが王となり、ジェームズは権力を失います。
local: With the wedding, Darnley becomes King and James loses his grip on power.
native: With the wedding, Darnley becomes King and James loses his grip on power.

en: He sees the marriage as a mistake, just like England's Elizabeth I did.
zh: 他認為這場婚姻是錯誤的，就像英格蘭的伊莉莎白一世一樣。
ja: 彼はこの結婚を誤りと見なし、イングランドのエリザベス1世も同様でした。
local: He sees the marriage as a mistake, just like England's Elizabeth I did.
native: He sees the marriage as a mistake, just like England's Elizabeth I did.

en: Tensions continue to escalate, Mary's wedding sparks widespread unrest and leads to open conflict
zh: 緊張局勢持續升級，瑪麗的婚禮引發廣泛動盪並導致公開衝突，
ja: 緊張が続き、メアリーの結婚は広範な不安を引き起こし、公開の対立へと発展します。
local: Tensions continue to escalate, Mary's wedding sparks widespread unrest and leads to open conflict
native: Tensions continue to escalate, Mary's wedding sparks widespread unrest and leads to open conflict

en: with her half-brother. James Stewart, now Earl of Moray, rises up against the Queen and ignites a rebellion.
zh: 與她的同父異母兄弟。詹姆斯·斯圖爾特，現任莫雷伯爵，起兵反抗女王並引發叛亂。
ja: 彼女の異母兄弟であるジェームズ・スチュアートは、現在モレイ伯爵として女王に反旗を翻し、反乱を引き起こします。
local: with her half-brother. James Stewart, now Earl of Moray, rises up against the Queen and ignites a rebellion.
native: with her half-brother. James Stewart, now Earl of Moray, rises up against the Queen and ignites a rebellion.

en: The pregnant Queen finds shelter behind the mighty walls of Edinburgh Castle.
zh: 懷孕的女王在愛丁堡城堡堅固的城牆後尋求庇護。
ja: 妊娠中の女王はエディンバラ城の強固な城壁の後ろに避難します。
local: The pregnant Queen finds shelter behind the mighty walls of Edinburgh Castle.
native: The pregnant Queen finds shelter behind the mighty walls of Edinburgh Castle.

en: Up there above the city, Mary Stewart gives birth to a healthy son in June 1566.
zh: 在城市之上，瑪麗·斯圖爾特於1566年6月生下一名健康的兒子。
ja: 街の上のその場所で、メアリー・スチュアートは1566年6月に健康な男児を出産します。
local: Up there above the city, Mary Stewart gives birth to a healthy son in June 1566.
native: Up there above the city, Mary Stewart gives birth to a healthy son in June 1566.

en: A boy who one day go on to change the course of two kingdoms history in ways no one could have
zh: 這個男孩將來會以無人能預見的方式改變兩個王國的歷史進程，
ja: その少年はいつの日か、誰も予想しなかった方法で二つの王国の歴史の流れを変えることになります。
local: A boy who one day go on to change the course of two kingdoms history in ways no one could have
native: A boy who one day go on to change the course of two kingdoms history in ways no one could have

en: foreseen, he's given the traditional Scottish royal name James. In England he will later ascend
zh: 他被賦予傳統的蘇格蘭王室名字詹姆斯。日後他將在英格蘭登基，
ja: 予見できなかった方法で、彼は伝統的なスコットランドの王名ジェームズを授かります。後にイングランドで即位します。
local: foreseen, he's given the traditional Scottish royal name James. In England he will later ascend
native: foreseen, he's given the traditional Scottish royal name James. In England he will later ascend

en: the throne as James I, the first ruler to unite Scotland and England.
zh: 成為詹姆斯一世，首位統一蘇格蘭與英格蘭的統治者。
ja: ジェームズ1世として王位に就き、スコットランドとイングランドを統一した最初の支配者となります。
local: the throne as James I, the first ruler to unite Scotland and England.
native: the throne as James I, the first ruler to unite Scotland and England.

en: While people celebrate the father stays away, King Darnley misses both the christening and
zh: 當人們慶祝時，父親卻缺席，達恩利國王既未出席洗禮也未參加
ja: 人々が祝う中、父親は姿を見せず、ダーンリー王は洗礼式も祝宴も欠席します。
local: While people celebrate the father stays away, King Darnley misses both the christening and
native: While people celebrate the father stays away, King Darnley misses both the christening and

en: festivities. He increasingly loses himself in games, drink and debauchery. He feels more at home
zh: 慶祝活動。他越來越沉迷於遊戲、飲酒和放蕩。他覺得在酒館和妓院比在皇宮更自在。
ja: 祝宴に参加しません。彼は次第にゲームや酒、放蕩に溺れていきます。宮廷よりも酒場や売春宿の方が居心地が良いと感じています。
local: festivities. He increasingly loses himself in games, drink and debauchery. He feels more at home
native: festivities. He increasingly loses himself in games, drink and debauchery. He feels more at home

en: in taverns and brothels than at the royal court. Four months later his enemies see their chance.
zh: 四個月後，他的敵人看到了機會。
ja: 宮廷よりも酒場や売春宿の方が居心地が良いと感じています。4か月後、彼の敵たちはチャンスを見つけます。
local: in taverns and brothels than at the royal court. Four months later his enemies see their chance.
native: in taverns and brothels than at the royal court. Four months later his enemies see their chance.

en: Darnley falls ill with smallpox and retreats to a small house outside the city walls of Edinburgh.
zh: 達恩利患上天花，退居愛丁堡城牆外的一座小屋。
ja: ダーンリーは天然痘にかかり、エディンバラの城壁外の小さな家に退避します。
local: Darnley falls ill with smallpox and retreats to a small house outside the city walls of Edinburgh.
native: Darnley falls ill with smallpox and retreats to a small house outside the city walls of Edinburgh.

en: What happens next feels like a play only this one ends in death.
zh: 接下來發生的事情像是一齣戲劇，但這場戲以死亡收場。
ja: 次に起こることはまるで芝居のようですが、これは死で終わるものです。
local: What happens next feels like a play only this one ends in death.
native: What happens next feels like a play only this one ends in death.

en: In the night around two o'clock, a huge explosion tears the house apart.
zh: 凌晨約兩點，一場巨大的爆炸摧毀了房子。
ja: 夜の2時頃、大きな爆発が家を引き裂きます。
local: In the night around two o'clock, a huge explosion tears the house apart.
native: In the night around two o'clock, a huge explosion tears the house apart.

en: Darnley isn't found beneath the rubble but lying in the garden, he's dead. There are no
zh: 達恩利沒有在瓦礫下被發現，而是躺在花園裡，他已經死了。沒有
ja: ダーンリーは瓦礫の下ではなく庭に横たわっており、死亡しています。火傷はありません。
local: Darnley isn't found beneath the rubble but lying in the garden, he's dead. There are no
native: Darnley isn't found beneath the rubble but lying in the garden, he's dead. There are no

en: burns on him, just distinct marks clearly visible around his neck. On the same day, rumours start.
zh: 燒傷，只有明顯的頸部痕跡。同一天，謠言開始流傳。
ja: 彼には火傷はなく、首の周りに明確な痕跡があります。同じ日に噂が始まります。
local: burns on him, just distinct marks clearly visible around his neck. On the same day, rumours start.
native: burns on him, just distinct marks clearly visible around his neck. On the same day, rumours start.

en: James Hepburn, Earl of Bothwell, is said to have murdered the King. Bothwell is charged but
zh: 據說博斯韋爾伯爵詹姆斯·赫本謀殺了國王。博斯韋爾被控告但
ja: ボスウェル伯爵ジェームズ・ヘプバーンが王を殺害したと言われています。ボスウェルは起訴されますが、
local: James Hepburn, Earl of Bothwell, is said to have murdered the King. Bothwell is charged but
native: James Hepburn, Earl of Bothwell, is said to have murdered the King. Bothwell is charged but

en: acquitted for lack of evidence. The public is outraged, the court is thrown into turmoil.
zh: 因證據不足被判無罪。公眾憤怒，宮廷陷入混亂。
ja: 証拠不十分で無罪となります。民衆は激怒し、宮廷は混乱に陥ります。
local: acquitted for lack of evidence. The public is outraged, the court is thrown into turmoil.
native: acquitted for lack of evidence. The public is outraged, the court is thrown into turmoil.

en: And then comes the second act of this dramatic tale. Just a few weeks after Darnley's death,
zh: 接著是這個戲劇故事的第二幕。達恩利死後僅幾週，
ja: そしてこの劇的な物語の第二幕が始まります。ダーンリーの死からわずか数週間後、
local: And then comes the second act of this dramatic tale. Just a few weeks after Darnley's death,
native: And then comes the second act of this dramatic tale. Just a few weeks after Darnley's death,

en: Bothwell proposes marriage to the Queen.
zh: 博斯韋爾向女王求婚。
ja: ボスウェルは女王に結婚を申し込みます。
local: Bothwell proposes marriage to the Queen.
native: Bothwell proposes marriage to the Queen.

en: He held the Queen there for three weeks cut off from the world. When she's finally released,
zh: 他將女王囚禁於此三週，與世隔絕。當她終於獲釋時，
ja: 彼は女王を3週間もそこに閉じ込め、外界から隔離しました。彼女がついに解放された時、
local: He held the Queen there for three weeks cut off from the world. When she's finally released,
native: He held the Queen there for three weeks cut off from the world. When she's finally released,

en: she's pregnant. Whether it was by force or of her own free will, nobody knows for sure to this day.
zh: 她懷孕了。至今沒有人確定這是強迫還是她自願的。
ja: 彼女は妊娠しています。強制されたのか自発的だったのか、今でも誰も確かには知りません。
local: she's pregnant. Whether it was by force or of her own free will, nobody knows for sure to this day.
native: she's pregnant. Whether it was by force or of her own free will, nobody knows for sure to this day.

en: But the suspicion remains. Bruceville is abusing his power over her, and Maria she's not
zh: 但懷疑依然存在。布魯斯維爾濫用對她的權力，而瑪麗亞她並沒有
ja: しかし疑いは残ります。ブルースヴィルは彼女に対して権力を乱用しており、メアリーは
local: But the suspicion remains. Bruceville is abusing his power over her, and Maria she's not
native: But the suspicion remains. Bruceville is abusing his power over her, and Maria she's not

en: running away from shame or scandal. No, just a few weeks later she actually goes and marries him,
zh: 逃避恥辱或醜聞。不，僅幾週後她真的嫁給了他，
ja: 恥やスキャンダルから逃げているわけではありません。いいえ、数週間後に彼女は実際に彼と結婚します。
local: running away from shame or scandal. No, just a few weeks later she actually goes and marries him,
native: running away from shame or scandal. No, just a few weeks later she actually goes and marries him,

en: the man suspected of killing her husband.
zh: 這個被懷疑殺害她丈夫的男人。
ja: 彼女の夫を殺害したと疑われている男です。
local: the man suspected of killing her husband.
native: the man suspected of killing her husband.

en: Can Mary Stuart remain queen under these circumstances? That's the question on everyone's lips across Europe.
zh: 在這種情況下，瑪麗·斯圖爾特能繼續當女王嗎？這是全歐洲人人關心的問題。
ja: この状況でメアリー・スチュアートは女王の座にとどまれるのでしょうか？それがヨーロッパ中の人々の関心事です。
local: Can Mary Stuart remain queen under these circumstances? That's the question on everyone's lips across Europe.
native: Can Mary Stuart remain queen under these circumstances? That's the question on everyone's lips across Europe.

en: The country's sinking into chaos and full-blown civil war, crown loyalists on one side on the other,
zh: 國家陷入混亂和全面內戰，一方是王室忠誠者，另一方是
ja: 国は混乱と全面的な内戦に陥り、一方には王冠の忠誠者、もう一方には
local: The country's sinking into chaos and full-blown civil war, crown loyalists on one side on the other,
native: The country's sinking into chaos and full-blown civil war, crown loyalists on one side on the other,

en: the powerful Protestant nobility, just north of Edinburgh, the two armies finally meet.
zh: 強大的新教貴族。在愛丁堡北部，兩軍終於交戰。
ja: 強力なプロテスタント貴族がいます。エディンバラの北で、両軍はついに対峙します。
local: the powerful Protestant nobility, just north of Edinburgh, the two armies finally meet.
native: the powerful Protestant nobility, just north of Edinburgh, the two armies finally meet.

en: A day of mud, fear and blood fight on till evening, then strength gives out.
zh: 一整天的泥濘、恐懼和血戰持續到傍晚，然後體力耗盡。
ja: 泥と恐怖と血の戦いが夕方まで続き、やがて力尽きます。
local: A day of mud, fear and blood fight on till evening, then strength gives out.
native: A day of mud, fear and blood fight on till evening, then strength gives out.

en: Thirsty, completely drained and hungry, they leave the field, the Queen has been defeated.
zh: 口渴、精疲力竭且飢餓，他們離開戰場，女王被擊敗了。
ja: 喉が渇き、完全に疲れ果て、空腹のまま、彼らは戦場を去り、女王は敗北しました。
local: Thirsty, completely drained and hungry, they leave the field, the Queen has been defeated.
native: Thirsty, completely drained and hungry, they leave the field, the Queen has been defeated.

en: Boswell, though, escapes. He flees across the sea to Scandinavia, where he's captured and imprisoned
zh: 然而博斯韋爾逃脫了。他逃往斯堪的納維亞，被捕並監禁，
ja: しかしボスウェルは逃げ延びます。彼は海を渡ってスカンジナビアに逃げ、そこで捕らえられ投獄されます。
local: Boswell, though, escapes. He flees across the sea to Scandinavia, where he's captured and imprisoned
native: Boswell, though, escapes. He flees across the sea to Scandinavia, where he's captured and imprisoned

en: until his death. Mary would never see him again. After the defeat, the lords take their queen captive.
zh: 直到他去世。瑪麗再也沒見過他。敗北後，諸侯將女王囚禁。
ja: 彼は死ぬまで投獄されます。メアリーは二度と彼に会うことはありません。敗北後、領主たちは女王を捕らえます。
local: until his death. Mary would never see him again. After the defeat, the lords take their queen captive.
native: until his death. Mary would never see him again. After the defeat, the lords take their queen captive.

en: They place Mary under arrest and begin putting intense pressure on her, by threatening violence,
zh: 他們逮捕瑪麗，開始對她施加巨大壓力，威脅使用暴力，
ja: 彼らはメアリーを逮捕し、暴力をちらつかせて彼女に強い圧力をかけ始めます。
local: They place Mary under arrest and begin putting intense pressure on her, by threatening violence,
native: They place Mary under arrest and begin putting intense pressure on her, by threatening violence,

en: they force her to abdicate. Her son, James, just 13 months old, becomes the new king of Scotland.
zh: 他們迫使她退位。她的兒子詹姆斯，僅13個月大，成為蘇格蘭的新國王。
ja: 彼女に退位を強要します。彼女の息子ジェームズはわずか13か月で、スコットランドの新しい王となります。
local: they force her to abdicate. Her son, James, just 13 months old, becomes the new king of Scotland.
native: they force her to abdicate. Her son, James, just 13 months old, becomes the new king of Scotland.

en: He grows up safe and away from the turmoil at sterling castle. Real power goes to his guardian,
zh: 他在斯特林城堡安全長大，遠離動亂。真正的權力落在他的監護人手中，
ja: 彼はスターリング城で安全に育ち、混乱から離れています。実権は彼の後見人に渡ります。
local: He grows up safe and away from the turmoil at sterling castle. Real power goes to his guardian,
native: He grows up safe and away from the turmoil at sterling castle. Real power goes to his guardian,

en: James, Mary's half-brother. He rules Scotland once again.
zh: 瑪麗的同父異母兄弟詹姆斯。他再次統治蘇格蘭。
ja: メアリーの異母兄弟ジェームズが再びスコットランドを支配します。
local: James, Mary's half-brother. He rules Scotland once again.
native: James, Mary's half-brother. He rules Scotland once again.

en: For Mary Stuart, the wheel of fate turns. Imprisoned in lock-leavened castle, she suffers a miscarriage.
zh: 對瑪麗·斯圖爾特來說，命運的輪轉動了。被囚禁在洛克利文城堡，她流產了。
ja: メアリー・スチュアートにとって運命の輪が回ります。ロックリーヴン城に囚われ、流産を経験します。
local: For Mary Stuart, the wheel of fate turns. Imprisoned in lock-leavened castle, she suffers a miscarriage.
native: For Mary Stuart, the wheel of fate turns. Imprisoned in lock-leavened castle, she suffers a miscarriage.

en: After 11 months, she manages to escape, fleeing the castle in a daring nighttime bid.
zh: 11個月後，她成功逃脫，勇敢地在夜間逃離城堡。
ja: 11か月後、彼女は脱出に成功し、夜間の大胆な試みで城を逃げ出します。
local: After 11 months, she manages to escape, fleeing the castle in a daring nighttime bid.
native: After 11 months, she manages to escape, fleeing the castle in a daring nighttime bid.

en: Days later, she's gathered a force of 6,000 loyal followers. She marches once again into battle
zh: 幾天後，她聚集了6000名忠誠的追隨者。她再次帶兵上戰場，
ja: 数日後、彼女は6,000人の忠実な支持者を集め、再び戦いに向かいます。
local: Days later, she's gathered a force of 6,000 loyal followers. She marches once again into battle
native: Days later, she's gathered a force of 6,000 loyal followers. She marches once again into battle

en: against the Protestant lords, but when it becomes clear that this battle too is lost,
zh: 對抗新教貴族，但當明顯這場戰鬥也失敗時，
ja: プロテスタントの領主たちに対して戦いますが、この戦いも敗北が明らかになると、
local: against the Protestant lords, but when it becomes clear that this battle too is lost,
native: against the Protestant lords, but when it becomes clear that this battle too is lost,

en: Mary Stuart hastily flees the field. Alone and defeated, she flees to England in the hope
zh: 瑪麗·斯圖爾特匆忙撤退。孤身一人且被擊敗，她逃往英格蘭，希望
ja: メアリー・スチュアートは急いで戦場を離れます。孤独で敗北した彼女は、保護を求めてイングランドに逃げ込みます。
local: Mary Stuart hastily flees the field. Alone and defeated, she flees to England in the hope
native: Mary Stuart hastily flees the field. Alone and defeated, she flees to England in the hope

en: of finding protection, but instead, she ends up under house arrest closely guarded in the name
zh: 尋求保護，但結果她被軟禁，受到嚴密看守，名義上是
ja: 保護を求めてですが、代わりに彼女は軟禁され、厳重に監視されます。
local: of finding protection, but instead, she ends up under house arrest closely guarded in the name
native: of finding protection, but instead, she ends up under house arrest closely guarded in the name

en: of Queen Elizabeth I. Years pass, to all appearances Mary seems powerless for 19 years.
zh: 伊莉莎白一世女王的名義。多年過去，表面上瑪麗似乎無力反抗19年。
ja: エリザベス1世女王の名のもとに。年月が過ぎ、メアリーは19年間無力に見えます。
local: of Queen Elizabeth I. Years pass, to all appearances Mary seems powerless for 19 years.
native: of Queen Elizabeth I. Years pass, to all appearances Mary seems powerless for 19 years.

en: Locked away far from her homeland, but behind castle walls, she's still plotting.
zh: 被關押在遠離故鄉的地方，但在城堡牆後，她仍在策劃。
ja: 故郷から遠く離れて閉じ込められていますが、城壁の内側で彼女はまだ陰謀を企てています。
local: Locked away far from her homeland, but behind castle walls, she's still plotting.
native: Locked away far from her homeland, but behind castle walls, she's still plotting.

en: She never gives up her claim to the English throne. Elizabeth spy master Walsingham watches her
zh: 她從未放棄對英格蘭王位的主張。伊莉莎白的間諜主管沃爾辛厄姆密切監視她，
ja: 彼女はイングランドの王位への権利を決して諦めません。エリザベスの諜報長官ウォルシンガムは彼女を監視しています。
local: She never gives up her claim to the English throne. Elizabeth spy master Walsingham watches her
native: She never gives up her claim to the English throne. Elizabeth spy master Walsingham watches her

en: closely, just waiting for a mistake, for a letter, a single sentence, a confession.
zh: 密切關注，只等待她犯錯，一封信，一句話，一個供詞。
ja: 注意深く見守り、彼女のミスや手紙、一言の文、告白を待っています。
local: closely, just waiting for a mistake, for a letter, a single sentence, a confession.
native: closely, just waiting for a mistake, for a letter, a single sentence, a confession.

en: And then it happens. Mary Stuart gets involved in a plot.
zh: 然後事情發生了。瑪麗·斯圖爾特捲入了一場陰謀。
ja: そしてそれが起こります。メアリー・スチュアートは陰謀に関与します。
local: And then it happens. Mary Stuart gets involved in a plot.
native: And then it happens. Mary Stuart gets involved in a plot.

en: Elizabeth is to be overthrown, and she herself installed on the throne as Catholic Queen.
zh: 伊莉莎白將被推翻，而她自己將作為天主教女王登基。
ja: エリザベスが打倒され、彼女自身がカトリックの女王として王位に就く計画です。
local: Elizabeth is to be overthrown, and she herself installed on the throne as Catholic Queen.
native: Elizabeth is to be overthrown, and she herself installed on the throne as Catholic Queen.

en: In an encrypted letter, Mary gives her approval for the murder of Elizabeth.
zh: 在一封加密信中，瑪麗批准了謀殺伊莉莎白的計劃。
ja: 暗号化された手紙で、メアリーはエリザベスの殺害を承認します。
local: In an encrypted letter, Mary gives her approval for the murder of Elizabeth.
native: In an encrypted letter, Mary gives her approval for the murder of Elizabeth.

en: This is the moment Walsingham has been waiting for. He intercepts the letter,
zh: 這是沃爾辛厄姆一直等待的時刻。他截獲了信件，
ja: これがウォルシンガムが待ち望んでいた瞬間です。彼は手紙を傍受し、
local: This is the moment Walsingham has been waiting for. He intercepts the letter,
native: This is the moment Walsingham has been waiting for. He intercepts the letter,

en: deciphers it, and presents it to Elizabeth I. The evidence is clear. Mary Stuart has agreed to
zh: 解密後呈交給伊莉莎白一世。證據明確。瑪麗·斯圖爾特已同意
ja: 解読してエリザベス1世に提示します。証拠は明白です。メアリー・スチュアートは同意しました。
local: deciphers it, and presents it to Elizabeth I. The evidence is clear. Mary Stuart has agreed to
native: deciphers it, and presents it to Elizabeth I. The evidence is clear. Mary Stuart has agreed to

en: the conspiracy. She is brought to trial. She's charged with high treason. Mary denies everything.
zh: 這場陰謀。她被提審，控以叛國罪。瑪麗否認一切。
ja: 陰謀に加担したとして裁判にかけられます。反逆罪で起訴されますが、メアリーはすべてを否定します。
local: the conspiracy. She is brought to trial. She's charged with high treason. Mary denies everything.
native: the conspiracy. She is brought to trial. She's charged with high treason. Mary denies everything.

en: She claims the notorious Babington letter was forged, but nobody believes her, and a new law is clear.
zh: 她聲稱臭名昭著的巴賓頓信是偽造的，但沒有人相信她，新法律明確規定。
ja: 彼女は悪名高いバビントンの手紙は偽造だと主張しますが、誰も信じません。新しい法律は明確です。
local: She claims the notorious Babington letter was forged, but nobody believes her, and a new law is clear.
native: She claims the notorious Babington letter was forged, but nobody believes her, and a new law is clear.

en: Anyone involved in a plot against Queen Elizabeth, or who benefits from it, must die.
zh: 任何參與反對伊莉莎白女王陰謀或從中受益者，必須處死。
ja: エリザベス女王に対する陰謀に関与した者、またはそれから利益を得た者は死刑に処されます。
local: Anyone involved in a plot against Queen Elizabeth, or who benefits from it, must die.
native: Anyone involved in a plot against Queen Elizabeth, or who benefits from it, must die.

en: On this basis, Mary Stuart is sentenced to death. She dies beneath the executioner's
zh: 基於此，瑪麗·斯圖爾特被判死刑。她在行刑者的刀下死去，
ja: この理由でメアリー・スチュアートは死刑判決を受けます。彼女は処刑人の手で命を落とします。
local: On this basis, Mary Stuart is sentenced to death. She dies beneath the executioner's
native: On this basis, Mary Stuart is sentenced to death. She dies beneath the executioner's

en: acts officially for treason. Yet the people continue to call her a martyr.
zh: 正式以叛國罪名處死。然而人民仍稱她為殉道者。
ja: 反逆罪で正式に処刑されますが、人々は彼女を殉教者と呼び続けます。
local: acts officially for treason. Yet the people continue to call her a martyr.
native: acts officially for treason. Yet the people continue to call her a martyr.

en: After her execution, the aging Elizabeth's marriage and alliance plans come to a halt.
zh: 她被處決後，年邁的伊莉莎白的婚姻和聯盟計劃停滯不前。
ja: 彼女の処刑後、老齢のエリザベスの結婚と同盟計画は停止します。
local: After her execution, the aging Elizabeth's marriage and alliance plans come to a halt.
native: After her execution, the aging Elizabeth's marriage and alliance plans come to a halt.

en: She remains alone, unmarried, childless, in 1603 Elizabeth I dies.
zh: 她孤身一人，未婚無子，1603年伊莉莎白一世去世。
ja: 彼女は独り身で未婚、子供もなく、1603年にエリザベス1世は亡くなります。
local: She remains alone, unmarried, childless, in 1603 Elizabeth I dies.
native: She remains alone, unmarried, childless, in 1603 Elizabeth I dies.

en: The throne passes to Mary Stuart's son, James. He becomes King James I of England.
zh: 王位傳給瑪麗·斯圖爾特的兒子詹姆斯。他成為英格蘭的詹姆斯一世國王。
ja: 王位はメアリー・スチュアートの息子ジェームズに渡り、彼はイングランドのジェームズ1世となります。
local: The throne passes to Mary Stuart's son, James. He becomes King James I of England.
native: The throne passes to Mary Stuart's son, James. He becomes King James I of England.

en: With him, the centuries-long conflict between England and Scotland comes to an end.
zh: 隨著他，英格蘭與蘇格蘭長達數世紀的衝突結束了。
ja: 彼と共に、イングランドとスコットランドの何世紀にもわたる対立が終わります。
local: With him, the centuries-long conflict between England and Scotland comes to an end.
native: With him, the centuries-long conflict between England and Scotland comes to an end.

en: Both kingdoms are now united under one single crown.
zh: 兩個王國現在統一於同一王冠之下。
ja: 両王国は今、一つの王冠の下に統一されました。
local: Both kingdoms are now united under one single crown.
native: Both kingdoms are now united under one single crown.

en: With Elizabeth, the Tudor dynasty dies out, and the descendants of Mary Stuart rule England to this day.
zh: 隨著伊莉莎白，都鐸王朝滅亡，瑪麗·斯圖爾特的後代至今統治英格蘭。
ja: エリザベスの時代に都ドー朝は絶え、メアリー・スチュアートの子孫が現在までイングランドを支配しています。
local: With Elizabeth, the Tudor dynasty dies out, and the descendants of Mary Stuart rule England to this day.
native: With Elizabeth, the Tudor dynasty dies out, and the descendants of Mary Stuart rule England to this day.
